ef47e768: A classic welcome means waiting: the flight is late, the guest is stuck in traffic, and your evening is gone. With several apartments it becomes a job in itself. Self check-in brings:
98e23fd6: Flexibility for guests. They can arrive at any time, without arranging or waiting.
273bdc8b: Free time for you. You don't have to be physically present at every arrival.

0d9f140d: A better position on the platforms.

47ad9e21: Before installing a lock or key box at the building entrance, check the building rules and agree it with the manager or the neighbours. A box in a shared area without agreement quickly becomes a problem.
bb4ffd19: A new code for every guest. Change it after the guest leaves; on a smart lock set a code valid only for the dates of the stay.
1a9f75cf: A new code for every guest.
d85ea7df: Send the code late. 1–2 days before arrival, never in the listing or a public message.
28b37e67: A spare key. Batteries die, boxes jam. Make sure someone nearby has a spare key.
e1efa8dc: Don't put the address and the code in the same public post, e.g. in a review or on social media.

aa372039: Guest registration. With self check-in, guests still have to be registered as the regulations require. Collect the details in advance, e.g. with an online form before arrival.
6bb217c6: Send it a day or two before arrival, with photos of the entrance, the door and the key box.
d1333f43: Replace “photo 1, 2, 3” with real photographs. A guest in the dark in front of an unfamiliar building appreciates those most of all.

81882c2c: In the SmartStay guide the self check-in instructions go together with photos and a video of the entrance, the Wi-Fi password and the house rules. Guests open them with a link or QR code, and can enter their registration details before arrival through guest registration.
b24bb61d: Most do, especially those travelling late or who don't want to wait. But guests still expect to reach you if something goes wrong. Self check-in without quick replies to messages quickly ends in a bad review.
f5874a86: What if the guest can't open the box or the lock?
882b83b3: That's why a spare key with someone nearby and a phone that is answered in the evening matter. The most common cause is a mistyped code or the wrong door, and photos in the instructions prevent both.
f557d7f4: How often should I change the code?
711586fc: Ideally after every guest. With a key box it takes a minute; with a smart lock the code can expire automatically when the booking ends.
7163bad6: How are guests registered with self check-in?
72868954: The obligation to register guests applies whether or not you meet them in person. Collect the ID or passport details before arrival, e.g. with an online form, and register them as usual.
